about: These papers improve and diagnose how vision-language models reason over images, including latent visual reasoning, visual chain-of-thought and grounding.
Analyzing reasoning traces and reducing overthinking in large reasoning models through pruning, early stopping and search.
Improves how diffusion and flow models are guided and sampled, including classifier-free guidance, reward-guided and RL post-training, few-step generation and score-matching analysis.

subtopic: Graph Neural Networks and Foundation Models
about: GNN architectures, graph contrastive learning, temporal graphs and graph foundation models for node, link and graph tasks.
These papers analyze how transformers compute, covering in-context learning theory, looped transformers, attention sinks, massive activations and length generalization.

subtopic: Deep Network Theory and Learning Dynamics
about: These papers analyse ReLU and residual networks theoretically, covering implicit bias, incremental learning, parameter symmetries, identifiability and feature learning.

subtopic: Tool-Use, Web and GUI Agent Benchmarks
about: Benchmarks and evaluation suites for tool-using, web, GUI and professional-workflow language agents.
Builds and accelerates feed-forward and streaming multi-view geometry transformers for 3D reconstruction, camera pose, depth and panoramic geometry estimation.
These papers probe what computations transformers perform internally, such as in-context learning, copying, belief states and hidden reasoning over filler tokens.
These papers study how LLMs are evaluated, covering benchmark design and reliability, judge bias, leaderboard rankings and AI peer review.

subtopic: LLM Behavioral Tendencies and Evaluation Awareness
about: Evaluating LLM behaviors such as sycophancy, deception, confirmation bias, moral reasoning, risk attitudes and evaluation awareness.
Structured pruning, layer removal and mixture-of-experts compression to make large language models cheaper to store and serve.
Training, fine-tuning, analysing and evaluating vision-language-action models for robotic manipulation.
Denoising, super-resolution, image fusion and plug-and-play or diffusion-based restoration of degraded images.
Segmentation, representation learning and vision-language models for radiology, CT and whole-slide pathology images.
Large audio language models, speech recognition, speech enhancement, audio generation and sign language recognition.
These papers develop masked and discrete diffusion language models, focusing on parallel decoding, speculative sampling, unmasking strategies and RL post-training.
These papers make image diffusion models faster and higher-resolution through feature caching, few-step distillation, pixel-space diffusion and diffusion-based super-resolution.
These papers help multimodal LLMs answer questions over long and streaming videos via frame selection, token allocation, KV-cache memory and agentic pipelines.
Making LLM agents more reliable, safe and cost-efficient through tool-call decisions, failure prediction, abstention and resource control.
These papers analyse and design neural-network optimizers such as Muon, Adam, Lion and SignSGD, covering orthogonalized updates, momentum and edge-of-stability dynamics.
Off-policy corrections, importance ratios, entropy control and credit assignment for stable reinforcement learning post-training of LLMs.
These papers improve image-text alignment in CLIP-style and vision-language models for compositional understanding, long captions and image retrieval.
Convergence rates for stochastic, decentralized, minimax and nonconvex gradient methods, including heavy-tailed noise and step-size schedules.
These papers study how multimodal models combine modalities, addressing modality imbalance, missing modalities, cross-modal alignment and synergy.
These papers train models across distributed clients with non-IID data, covering aggregation, personalization, federated LoRA, robustness and privacy.

subtopic: LLMs for Optimization Modeling and Algorithm Design
about: These papers use LLMs, often with evolutionary search, to formulate optimization models, discover algorithms and generate engineering or combinatorial code, with benchmarks for each.
Proposes low-rank, sparse, orthogonal and zeroth-order adapter variants and optimizers for fine-tuning large language models with less memory and compute.
Forecasting architectures and time series foundation models for multivariate, long-horizon and non-stationary data.
New formulations, theory and constrained or distilled variants of flow matching and transport-based generative models.
Position and empirical papers on human oversight, AI-assisted decisions, governance and how AI systems should be evaluated with people.
General deep reinforcement learning methods covering representation learning, multitask, meta, transfer, safe and model-based RL.
Benchmarks probing multimodal models on specialised imagery such as remote sensing, medical scans, documents, try-on and image quality.
Designs, scales and detects jailbreak and red-teaming attacks on LLMs, multimodal and diffusion language models, along with safety defenses.
These papers make long-context language models efficient through sparse attention, linear RNNs and state-space models, and positional encodings that extend context length.
These papers learn dexterous hand-object interaction, humanoid loco-manipulation and contact-rich control, often from egocentric human videos and tactile or force signals.

subtopic: LLM Agent Safety and Prompt Injection
about: Benchmarks and defends LLM, computer-use and multi-agent systems against prompt injection, unsafe actions, sabotage and scheming.
Improving and evaluating text-to-image models via reward models, compositional control, aesthetics and bias analysis.
Data-centric studies of benchmarks, model selection, cascades and evaluation pitfalls in how model behavior is measured.
Adapting, fine-tuning, distilling and robustifying CLIP-style vision-language models and vision transformers under distribution shift.
Develops open-world, domain-adaptive and long-tailed object detectors and methods for detecting out-of-distribution inputs in vision models.
Designing, training and evaluating teams of collaborating or debating LLM agents, including coordination and orchestration.

subtopic: Mechanism Design, Auctions and Social Choice
about: Designs and analyzes auctions, pricing, resource allocation, persuasion and voting rules for strategic agents, often with learning-augmented guarantees.

subtopic: LiDAR and Radar Perception for Driving
about: These papers handle LiDAR, radar and multi-sensor data for localization, point-cloud registration, scene flow and HD map construction in driving and UAV settings.
These papers design and analyze samplers built on diffusion models, Langevin dynamics and sequential Monte Carlo, including posterior sampling for inverse problems.
Neural operator and transformer surrogates that learn to solve partial differential equations for physical simulation and forecasting.
Statistical theory for linear regression, covariance estimation and inference under heavy tails, corruption and high dimensions.
These papers train teams of agents to coordinate and explore in cooperative or mixed-motive multi-agent reinforcement learning and Markov games.
Analyzes and designs embedding spaces using manifold, hyperbolic, Riemannian, spherical and topological structure for representation learning.
These papers extend video diffusion models to long or streaming generation with autoregressive rollout, memory for consistency, and distillation for real-time speed.
Explains why overparameterized networks generalize, covering grokking, double descent, memorization versus generalization and compression-based bounds.
These papers study how safety alignment and refusal behavior in LLMs and multimodal models hold up, break under jailbreaks or fine-tuning, and can be made more robust.
These papers improve 3D Gaussian splatting and neural rendering for novel view synthesis, including feed-forward reconstruction, compression and densification.
These papers compress LLM weights and activations to low bit-widths through post-training quantization, quantization-aware training and mixed-precision search.

subtopic: In-Context RL and Offline Policy Steering
about: These papers learn and adapt policies from fixed datasets, behavior foundation models and in-context RL, including safe offline RL and post-training policy steering.
These papers build and benchmark memory systems that let LLM agents store, retrieve and update past experience over long dialogues and tasks.
Studies reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for reasoning models, focusing on GRPO-style advantage estimation, rollout efficiency and training stability.
These papers localize actions, moments and objects in time and space in video, covering temporal grounding, video object segmentation and video reasoning segmentation.
Generating structured, part-decomposed or articulated 3D objects and scenes from images or text.
These papers ground language in 3D scenes for open-vocabulary understanding, spatial reasoning, affordances and localization using point clouds, multi-view images and 3D-LLMs.
End-to-end driving planners, driving VLA models, world models and benchmarks for autonomous vehicles.

subtopic: Regret Bounds for Stochastic and Contextual Bandits
about: Regret bounds and algorithms for stochastic, linear, contextual, dueling and cascading bandit problems.
Builds foundation models and generative methods for single-cell gene expression, spatial transcriptomics from histology, perturbation response and genomic sequences.
These papers study how language-model agents choose and combine reasoning strategies for planning, abstraction and scientific problem solving, often with new benchmarks.

subtopic: Policy Gradient and MDP Convergence Theory
about: These papers prove convergence and sample-complexity results for policy gradient, value iteration and off-policy evaluation in discounted and average-reward MDPs.
These papers develop and critique post-hoc explanation methods such as Shapley values, integrated gradients and causal attributions for model predictions.
These papers evaluate and build LLM agents for clinical reasoning, EHR tasks, medical QA and report generation, along with medical benchmarks.
Protein language models, structure prediction, docking and fitness prediction for biomolecules and drug discovery.
Models irregularly sampled and continuous-time sequences with neural CDEs, state-space models and point processes, often for EHR, ECG, sleep and wearable data.
Builds single models and visual tokenizers that both understand and generate images, including autoregressive and representation-autoencoder approaches.
Develops variational inference, neural posterior estimation, Gaussian process and Laplace methods for scalable and robust Bayesian inference.
Benchmarks and agentic methods for 3D and embodied spatial reasoning in vision-language models.
LLM agents that discover, store, reuse and evolve skills to solve long-horizon web, embodied and tool-use tasks.
Latent and symbolic world models that let robots and LLM agents predict outcomes and plan actions.
Analyzes learning and dynamics in low-rank RNNs, Hopfield networks and reservoirs as models of neural circuits and memory.
These papers detect anomalies in industrial images, time series, graphs, video and audio, including zero-shot and few-shot settings.
These papers build models and benchmarks for chemistry tasks such as reaction prediction, retrosynthesis, mass-spectrometry retrieval and machine-learned interatomic potentials.
Learned solvers, often diffusion or RL based, for routing, SAT, MILP and other constraint satisfaction problems.
Identifies latent and chaotic dynamical systems from observations using Koopman operators, neural ODEs/SDEs, switching models and equation discovery.
Detecting and reducing hallucinations in LLMs and vision-language models using uncertainty, token-level signals and training.
These papers benchmark and train LLM coding agents on repository-level software engineering, long-horizon development and debugging tasks.

subtopic: LLM Personas, Sycophancy and Cultural Bias
about: These papers measure how LLMs simulate personas and opinions and how they show sycophancy, stereotypes and cultural or value biases.
Evaluating and improving physical consistency, motion realism and world modeling in text-to-video generators.
Recovering dynamic 3D geometry, motion and human or object animation from monocular or multi-view video.
These papers build interactive, action-conditioned video world models for robots, games and embodied agents, sometimes combined with vision-language-action policies.
These papers generate 3D molecules, crystals, proteins and materials with equivariant diffusion, flow and autoregressive models, including structure-based drug design.
These papers shrink the memory cost of LLM inference by evicting, quantizing, pruning or reusing key-value cache entries.
These papers generate and edit videos with control over subjects, motion, identity and lighting, often by turning image editors into video editors.
DPO-style and RLHF objectives, data selection and robustness methods for aligning LLMs with human preferences.
These papers study predictions that feed into decisions, including performative prediction, predict-then-optimize, recalibration and learning-augmented algorithms.
Learning causal graphs and identifying causal effects with structural causal models, interventions and latent variables.
These papers update or edit the factual knowledge stored in LLMs and study the forgetting and memorization that happen during continual post-training.
Builds datasets, guidance schemes and RL training for editing images from text instructions, exemplars or drag inputs while preserving unedited content.
These papers learn new classes or tasks one after another without forgetting old ones, often with LoRA adapters, merging or optimizers built for stability and plasticity.
Teacher-student distillation where reasoning LLMs learn from teacher feedback on their own generated trajectories.
These papers prove sample-complexity and lower bounds for PAC, online and agnostic learning, especially of halfspaces and concept classes with VC or Littlestone dimension.

subtopic: Clustering Coresets and Nearest Neighbor Search
about: Algorithms and guarantees for coresets, k-means and k-center clustering, metric spaces and approximate nearest neighbor search.

subtopic: Multi-Turn LLM Dialogue and Agent RL
about: Reinforcement learning, credit assignment and evaluation for LLMs in multi-turn conversations and interactive agent tasks.

subtopic: Learning with Noisy and Weak Labels
about: These papers handle imperfect supervision such as label noise, partial and positive-unlabeled labels, class imbalance and active learning, along with surrogate-loss theory.

subtopic: Physics-Informed Networks and PDE Foundation Models
about: These papers solve partial differential equations with physics-informed networks, neural surrogates, PDE foundation models and generative inverse solvers.
Speeds up LLM generation and serving with draft-and-verify speculative decoding, tree drafting, self-speculation and scheduling.
Detecting and localizing AI-generated images, deepfake videos and image tampering for media forensics.
Builds benchmarks and pipelines for retrievers, embedding models, deep search and long-document understanding with evidence grounding.

subtopic: Treatment Effect Estimation and Causal Inference
about: These papers estimate heterogeneous and average treatment effects and counterfactual outcomes from observational, experimental and survival data.
These papers model user preferences for sequential, multimodal and generative recommendation, increasingly with LLMs and diffusion models.
Learning dynamics and sample complexity for reaching Nash or correlated equilibria in zero-sum, Markov and potential games.

subtopic: LLM Theorem Proving and Formal Math
about: Using LLMs for formal theorem proving in Lean, autoformalization, proof grading and math reasoning benchmarks.

subtopic: Multimodal Agents for Search and Deep Research
about: These papers evaluate and train multimodal LLM agents for web search, deep research, tool use and embodied decision-making, mostly through new benchmarks.
These papers fit, explain and extrapolate power-law scaling laws that relate loss to model size, data and compute, and derive compute-optimal training recipes.
Generating, predicting and recognizing human motion, dance, gestures, gait and sign from text, scenes or video.

subtopic: Brain Encoding and Neural Recording Analysis
about: Models fMRI, EEG and spiking recordings with encoding models, connectivity estimation and neural data tokenizers, plus connectomics benchmarks.
Applies machine learning to quantum systems and studies quantum neural networks, circuits, kernels, tomography and neural quantum states.
Offline and offline-to-online reinforcement learning using diffusion, flow-matching and generative policies trained on fixed datasets.

subtopic: Weather, Climate and Air Quality Forecasting
about: These papers forecast weather, air quality, cyclones and other environmental and energy quantities with ML models and new benchmarks.
Foundation models, benchmarks and datasets for EEG, ECG and other physiological signals in clinical and brain-computer interface settings.
Theoretical and statistical work on score-based diffusion models, density estimation, denoising and posterior inference for inverse problems.
Using LLMs and agents to write and tune CUDA or Triton kernels, plus benchmarks for HPC and ML systems code.
These papers remove the influence of specific training data from models, mainly LLMs, while preserving utility and resisting relearning.
These papers design differentially private training and accounting mechanisms, and audit privacy leakage with membership inference attacks.
These papers give provable algorithms for constrained, chance-constrained and robust Markov decision processes, often via primal-dual policy optimization.
These papers train and analyse spiking neural networks for energy-efficient neuromorphic computing, using learnable delays, neuron models and plasticity rules.
Formal verification and certified robustness of neural networks, plus backdoor attacks and provable defenses.
Generative models and optimization for designing proteins, antibodies, peptides, RNA and DNA sequences.
Sample-efficient black-box optimization with Gaussian process surrogates, acquisition functions and multi-objective Pareto search.
Controlling language model behaviour at inference time by editing internal activations with steering vectors or subspace interventions.
Embedding and detecting watermarks in LLM text, images and audio to trace AI-generated content.
Algorithms and optimal rates for statistical estimation, optimization and data analysis under central or local differential privacy.
Constructs conformal prediction sets and intervals with marginal, conditional or online coverage guarantees under shift, grouping and multivariate outputs.
Fair classification and regression, multigroup fairness, fairness audits and fairness-accuracy tradeoffs under sensitive attributes.

subtopic: Verified Code and Software Security Benchmarks
about: Evaluates LLMs on formally verified code generation, proof writing, vulnerability detection, reverse engineering and cybersecurity tasks.
These papers transfer models across distribution shifts through unsupervised, source-free and graph domain adaptation and domain generalization.
Generates and forecasts vehicle and human trajectories, traffic and spatio-temporal events in cities, including cross-city transfer and benchmarks.
In-context tabular foundation models such as TabPFN plus benchmarks, robustness, privacy and generation for tabular data.
Removing unsafe concepts or styles from text-to-image diffusion models, plus adversarial attacks and defenses on vision-language models.
Studies post-hoc calibration, multicalibration and prediction-powered inference for reliable estimates and evaluation with few labels.
These papers propose solvers and estimation theory for optimal transport, including Gromov-Wasserstein, sliced, unbalanced and barycenter problems.
These papers train RL agents to reach goals or satisfy formal task specifications such as temporal logic and reward machines, often offline and with subgoal planning.
Building, evaluating and stress-testing sparse autoencoders and dictionary learning to extract interpretable features from model activations.
These papers decode speech, images and intentions from brain recordings and build brain foundation models and datasets for brain-computer interfaces.

subtopic: Reward Models and Human Behavior Modeling
about: These papers mix reward and process-reward modeling for LLMs, including reward hacking, with computational models of human and animal decision-making behavior.
Derives regret guarantees for online convex and non-convex optimization under delays, switching costs, memory and bandit feedback.
Trains diffusion and flow-matching policies with policy gradients, Q-guidance and offline-to-online RL for multimodal continuous control.
Combining fine-tuned models, task vectors or LoRA adapters into a single model without retraining.
Retrieval-augmented generation over knowledge graphs and RL-trained search agents for multi-hop question answering.
Learns fused representations across multiple views or modalities for multi-view clustering, incomplete multi-view learning and person or object re-identification.
Improving faithfulness, efficiency, privacy and knowledge-conflict handling in retrieval-augmented LLM generation.
Gives sample-complexity bounds and algorithms for fixed-confidence and fixed-budget best-arm identification and pure exploration in bandits.
These papers speed up image and video diffusion transformers with post-training or quantization-aware quantization and trainable sparse attention.
Recovers causal graphs from observational, interventional or time-series data, including amortized foundation models and LLM-informed priors.
These papers propose diffusion, flow-matching, autoencoder and sequence models that generate graphs and hypergraphs at scale.
